newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BPI secondary offer price sets at 125 pesos.
newsitem.headline: BPI secondary offer price sets at 125 pesos.

text.p: The Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) said on Friday it had set the offer price for its secondary shares offering at 125 pesos per share.
Offering of the 49.741 million shares is to start on Friday and end on November 4.
Forty-six percent of the shares will be distributed locally, while the rest to foreign investors, the bank said in a statement.
Selling shareholders are the Morgan Guarantee International Finance Corp, Ayalafil Inc, BPI Capital Corp and the Madrigal family.
The lead underwriters are JP Morgan Securities Ltd and BPI Capital Corp.
BPI shares closed at 130 pesos per share on Thursday.
